Egypt Ready to Defend Saudi Arabia if Needed, Sisi Says
Egyptian President Abdel-Fattah El-Sisi said his nation stands ready to defend Saudi Arabia as it comes under attack from Yemen’s Houthis and called on parliament to convene an emergency session to authorize such action if it became necessary.
Speaking at a graduation ceremony at a military academy on Cairo’s outskirts on Saturday, Sisi said he would provide help if asked by the Saudi King or the crown prince.
